title: Cross-functional initiative signal hub and decision roles
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Problem: As we scale the number of company initiatives and distributed stakeholders across Dedicated, Private, and Console products, signals about initiative health and pending decisions are fragmented across Linear issues, Confluence docs, GitHub PRs, and ad-hoc Slack threads. This causes missed gating decisions, duplicate work, and long unblock cycles for cross-team dependencies.

Goal: Create a lightweight, operational ‘initiative signal hub’ and explicit decision-roles model so that at the company level we can: 1) surface critical gating signals for OKR-aligned initiatives, 2) reduce decision latency and imprecision about who can greenlight or block work, and 3) standardize weekly cadence for cross-functional alignment without adding heavy ceremony.
success_criteria: 1) 90% of new company-level initiatives have a documented decision owner and decision timeline at kickoff; 2) mean time to decision on cross-team questions reduces from current baseline by 40% within two cycles; 3) Product/Eng/Design report clarity score >= 4/5 in post-cycle survey for alignment on company OKRs.
acceptance_criteria:
- Signal hub MVP available as a Confluence template + Linear board mapping within the project.
- Decision-roles taxonomy (R/A/C/I-lite) published and adopted by PMs for company initiatives.
- Run two pilot initiatives through the hub and capture before/after latency metrics.
- Playbook published with templates and a 30-min weekly triage ritual for cross-functional leads.
proposed_solution:
Deliverables: (a) Confluence 'Initiative Signal Hub' template capturing context, OKR mapping, decision owner, decision timeline, critical signals (SLO breaches, cost delta estimates, customer escalations), and dependency table; (b) Linear cross-org board with custom views for gating signals and outstanding decisions; (c) Lightweight decision-roles doc defining 'Decision Owner', 'Technical Arbiter', and 'Escalation Path'; (d) Weekly 30-minute triage ritual run by PM lead with rotating recorder and public notes; (e) small Console dashboard card (product/ops) that surfaces initiatives with >1 unresolved critical signal.

Implementation notes: integrate the Linear board with Confluence via embedded links, tag initiative issues with `initiative:company` and `decision-pending` label for automated filtering. Create a GitHub docs PR template that mirrors the Confluence fields so engineering proposals feed the same signal model.
rollout_plan:
Phase 0 (2 weeks): draft templates, taxonomy, and friction map; Phase 1 (4 weeks): pilot with two initiatives (one infra/runtime improvement, one Console UX initiative); Phase 2 (4 weeks): iterate templates based on pilots, onboard PMs and Triage leads, automate label filters in Linear; Phase 3 (ongoing): expand to all company-level initiatives and measure metrics.

Communication: Kickoff doc + invite to stakeholder working group, recorded training session for PMs, and a short internal blog post summarizing expected behaviors.
metrics: - % initiatives with decision owner at kickoff; - Mean time (in days) from decision question raised to resolution; - # of initiatives with >2 unresolved critical signals at weekly triage; - Post-cycle alignment survey score (1-5).
